operating_notes.text: Secured two contiguous sections of 500 kV overhead transmission lines in the MENA region valued in the ultra-mega category (₹400+ Cr).
Secured transmission line package TL-01 for Bellary Davanagere 2nd 400kV D/c line from PGCIL with a 21-month execution period.
Total outstanding balance from customers under ongoing arbitration proceedings is INR 85.96 crores as at March 31, 2026.
FY26 standalone revenue from operations reached ₹2,792 Cr with PAT up 74% to ₹27 Cr.
Secured a Mega EPC order for a 400/220/33 KV GIS Substation from a Mumbai datacenter client with a 24-month execution period.
Order book of ₹4,055 Cr as on 30th June 2026
Manufacturing capacity expansion to 1,10,000 MT with committed capex of ₹170 crore
Won ₹200+ Cr (incl. GST) Major EPC order from Tata Power for 400 kV GIS Substations in Dharavi & Ghatkopar, Mumbai (18 months execution).
Secured highest-ever transmission EPC order worth ₹1,500 Cr (incl. GST) from Lakadia A Power Transmission Limited with a 36-month execution period.

timeline.summary: Niraj Bajaj, Promoter Group of Bajel Projects Ltd., declared no new encumbrances on shares held as of FY 2025-2026 under SEBI’s Regn 31(4).
Bajel Projects secured an ultra-mega order worth over ₹400 Cr for a 500 kV transmission line in the MENA region.
Bajel Projects secured a major EPC order from PGCIL worth up to ₹400 Cr for a 400kV transmission line under the Bellary-Davanagere RE evacuation scheme.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,007.77 Cr, net profit ₹14.14 Cr.
Bajel Projects reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹2,792 Cr and PAT of ₹27 Cr, recommending a maiden dividend of ₹0.60 per share.
Bajel Projects Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, at 03:00 PM (IST) for FY2025-26 results via its website.
Bajel Projects secured a Mega EPC order for a 400/220/33 KV GIS Substation from a Mumbai datacenter client.
Bajel Projects filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on June 3, 2026.
Bajel Projects reported Q1FY27 results with PAT up 37% YoY to ₹4.5 Cr and order book reaching a record ₹4,055 Cr.
Bajel Projects won a ₹200+ Cr Major EPC order from Tata Power for 400 kV GIS substations at Dharavi and Ghatkopar in Mumbai.
Bajel Projects secured its highest-ever transmission order worth ₹1,500 Cr from Lakadia A Power Transmission Limited on October 26, 2026.
